- Verification that my new credit card’s expiry date is correctly recorded.
- A detailed breakdown of the charges applied to my recent flight booking, including any applicable taxes, fees, or currency conversion rates.
- An updated and complete booking history for my account.

Please let me know if you require any additional information or documentation from my side to expedite this review. I am eager to resolve these inconsistencies promptly so that my travel expenses can be accurately reflected in my budget and accounting records.

Thank you for your assistance and prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
